name: After Hours #12 — After Encore Booth
description: The song list is still lit. Nobody is brave enough for one more. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 12 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 2.4-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
